note: The register of record is catalog/sources.json (120 sources, each with group, owner, language and how it is read: a publisher's feed, a Google News search by zone or topic, a Google News site: search for one outlet, a public Telegram channel, or GDELT alone) plus GDELT, the main source and the only one the attention counts use. catalog/blocklist.json lists the sites left out. The rows here add what the doctrine kit needs: Admiralty grades, independence, ease of faking, cadence and health probes.

grading.status: proposed 30 Oct 2026; Tom to confirm (iranian_exile added 31 Oct 2026, proposed C like russian_independent)
grading.reliability_basis: Admiralty reliability (A-F) of the outlet group, not of any one report. State media of a party to the conflict start at D; pro-war military bloggers at E; saved searches at F because the publisher behind each result varies (grade the publisher instead when it is known).
grading.credibility_rule: Credibility (1-6) is set per report: 3 for a single report, 2 once a second independent source confirms it (the two-source rule), 6 when it cannot be judged. Official claims stay 'claimed' (status_class) until an outlet outside that government reports them.

independence: Two sources are independent when they are different outlets and not owned by the same government (catalog/sources.json owner and group). Reprints of one story count once (stories are grouped before counting).

gdelt-gkg.descriptor: The GDELT Project's Global Knowledge Graph 2.1: machine-read world news (English and translated streams) every 15 minutes; articles grouped into stories by Watchfloor before counting.
gdelt-gkg.licence: GDELT terms: free for any use with a citation and a link to gdeltproject.org

gdelt-events.descriptor: The GDELT Project's Events 2.0 export: machine-coded CAMEO events with a geocoded place, every 15 minutes. Country-level counts only; single events can be misplaced.
gdelt-events.licence: GDELT terms: free for any use with a citation and a link to gdeltproject.org

watchfloor-api.descriptor: Watchfloor's own daily build (stories, zone measures, country lists), served by its public API.
